articles.summaryCn: 习近平主席在访问埃及前夕发表署名文章，回顾中埃70年友谊，展望深化全面战略伙伴关系与合作。

paragraphs.en:
Chinese President Xi Jinping on Tuesday published a signed article titled "Celebrating 70 Years of Solidarity, China and Egypt Embark on a New Journey" in Al-Ahram, Al-Akhbar and Al-Gomhuria ahead of his arrival in Egypt for a state visit. The following is the full text of the article:
H.E. Xi Jinping
President of the People's Republic of China
At the invitation of His Excellency President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi, I will be paying a state visit to Egypt and, as President of the People's Republic of China, setting foot for the second time on this land {{0}} by the Nile. Just as an Egyptian proverb reads, "Once you drink from the Nile, you are destined to return." During my last visit ten years ago, I was deeply impressed by the time-honored, {{1}} civilization of this country, together with its booming {{2}} and upward momentum. This time, I look forward to renewing the friendship and working together with President El-Sisi to explore ways of cooperation and map out a new {{3}} for deepening the China-Egypt comprehensive strategic partnership.
paragraphs.cn: 中国国家主席习近平在抵达埃及进行国事访问前夕，于周二在《金字塔报》、《消息报》和《共和国报》发表了题为《庆祝中埃建交70周年，携手开启新征程》的署名文章。以下是文章全文：中华人民共和国主席习近平应阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西总统阁下邀请，我将对埃及进行国事访问，并以中华人民共和国主席的身份第二次踏上这片由尼罗河滋养的土地。正如埃及谚语所说：“喝了尼罗河的水，注定还会回来。”十年前我上次访问时，这个国家悠久深厚的文明、蓬勃的活力和向上的势头给我留下了深刻印象。此次，我期待与塞西总统重温友谊，共同探讨合作途径，为深化中埃全面战略伙伴关系绘制新蓝图。

paragraphs.en: As a Chinese saying goes, "A partnership forged with the right approach defies distance." Known for their age-old civilizations, China and Egypt have each contributed an invaluable intellectual {{4}} and splendid cultural heritage to the progress of humanity. The Yangtze River and the Yellow River gave birth to the Chinese civilization, and the Nile was the {{5}} of the ancient Egyptian civilization. With porcelain and silk sailing the seas and {{6}} the deserts, the vast geographical distance never kept our two civilizations from appreciating each other, and friendly exchanges along the millennium-old ancient Silk Road never stopped. Chinese silk, porcelain, and paper-making, smelting and casting techniques made their way westward, while Egyptian aromatics, glassware and calendrical knowledge journeyed over thousands of miles eastward. The Chinese {{7}} unearthed in Fustat {{8}} to the close bonds and deep friendship that have existed between our peoples since ancient times.
paragraphs.cn: 中国有句古话：“志合者，不以山海为远。”中埃两国都以古老文明著称，各自为人类进步贡献了宝贵的思想遗产和灿烂的文化瑰宝。长江和黄河孕育了中华文明，尼罗河则是古埃及文明的摇篮。瓷器与丝绸漂洋过海、穿越沙漠，广阔的地理距离从未阻碍我们两大文明相互欣赏，千年古丝绸之路上的友好交往从未中断。中国的丝绸、瓷器、造纸、冶炼和铸造技术西传，而埃及的香料、玻璃器皿和历法知识则东行数千英里。在福斯塔特出土的中国文物见证了中埃人民自古以来就存在的紧密联系和深厚友谊。

paragraphs.en: Seventy years ago, China and Egypt officially established diplomatic relations, marking the start of New China's friendly cooperation with Arab and African countries. For seven decades, the China-Egypt relationship has braved wind and rain, and {{9}} the test of the changing international landscape. It has stayed on the right course, remained {{10}} as ever, and sustained a strong momentum. It is a fine example for China's cooperation with Arab states and Africa on the whole, and for friendship, {{11}} and collaboration between developing countries. — China and Egypt have always been close brothers standing by each other.
paragraphs.cn: 七十年前，中埃正式建立外交关系，标志着新中国与阿拉伯和非洲国家友好合作的开端。七十年来，中埃关系历经风雨，经受住了国际风云变幻的考验，始终沿着正确方向前进，保持强劲势头。它是中国同阿拉伯国家和非洲整体合作的典范，也是发展中国家友好团结协作的典范。——中埃始终是守望相助的亲密兄弟。

paragraphs.en: In the struggle for national independence and against imperialism and colonialism, the people of our two countries forged profound friendship. China firmly supported Egypt's sovereignty over the Suez Canal, and Egypt, alongside the majority of Asian, African, and Latin American and Caribbean countries, voted {{12}} in favor of the {{13}} of the lawful seat of the People's Republic of China in the United Nations. Currently, our two sides firmly support each other in pursuing development paths suited to our respective national conditions, and firmly support each other on core interests and major concerns. All this has laid a solid foundation for the China-Egypt comprehensive strategic partnership. — China and Egypt have always been reliable partners in win-win cooperation.
paragraphs.cn: 在争取民族独立、反对帝国主义和殖民主义的斗争中，两国人民结下了深厚友谊。中国坚定支持埃及对苏伊士运河的主权，埃及同广大亚洲、非洲、拉丁美洲和加勒比国家一道，明确投票赞成恢复中华人民共和国在联合国的合法席位。当前，双方坚定支持彼此探索符合本国国情的发展道路，在核心利益和重大关切问题上坚定相互支持。所有这些都为中埃全面战略伙伴关系奠定了坚实基础。——中埃始终是互利共赢的可靠伙伴。

paragraphs.en: Egypt is China's major trading and investment partner in the Arab world and Africa, and one of the first countries to participate in Belt and Road cooperation. As early as ten years ago, President El-Sisi and I jointly unveiled the China-Egypt Suez Economic and Trade Cooperation Zone. The project has drawn substantial investment, created a large number of local jobs, and helped in Egypt's endeavor to {{14}} its modernization. In other fields, fruits of mutually beneficial cooperation -- from Africa's tallest building and first intercity electric light rail built in Egypt by Chinese enterprises, to fresh Egyptian oranges heading for the Chinese market as the first African produce to {{15}} on China's zero-tariff policy for the African countries having diplomatic relations with it -- are shared by countless households in both countries. — China and Egypt have always been the role models of friendship and mutual learning.
paragraphs.cn: 埃及是中国在阿拉伯世界和非洲的主要贸易和投资伙伴，也是最早参与“一带一路”合作的国家之一。早在十年前，塞西总统和我共同启动了中埃苏伊士经贸合作区。该项目吸引了大量投资，创造了大量本地就业机会，助力埃及加快现代化进程。在其他领域，互利合作的成果——从中国企业承建的非洲最高建筑和首条城际电气化轻轨，到作为首个受益于中国对建交非洲国家零关税政策的非洲农产品、新鲜埃及橙子进入中国市场——惠及两国千家万户。——中埃始终是友好互鉴的典范。

paragraphs.en: Egypt is the first among both Arab nations and African countries to sign an agreement on cultural cooperation with New China, and our people-to-people exchanges have been {{16}} and {{17}}. The Grand Egyptian Museum is a must-visit for Chinese tourists, so much so that the exhibition "The Civilization of Ancient Egypt" in Shanghai Museum saw tickets sell out in seconds. In Egypt, the Chinese language is taught in more than 40 middle schools, and cooperation with China on vocational education has benefited numerous Egyptians. Across time and space, the two civilizations have been reaching out to each other, adding new chapters of everlasting friendship between the two peoples. — China and Egypt have always been sincere friends committed to equality and mutual trust.
paragraphs.cn: 埃及是第一个同新中国签署文化合作协定的阿拉伯和非洲国家，我们的人文交流丰富多彩。大埃及博物馆是中国游客的必访之地，以至于上海博物馆的“古埃及文明大展”门票数秒内售罄。在埃及，超过40所中学教授中文，与中国的职业教育合作惠及众多埃及民众。跨越时空，两大文明相互走近，为中埃人民之间的永恒友谊增添了新篇章。——中埃始终是平等互信的真诚朋友。

paragraphs.en: At the Bandung Conference in 1955, our two countries actively supported the anti-imperial and anti-colonial struggle, and jointly advanced Asian-African solidarity. Today, China and Egypt have shared goals and common {{18}} in upholding international order, championing fairness and justice, and practicing {{19}}. Both sides firmly support the just cause of the Palestinian people in restoring their {{20}} national rights, and both are committed to facilitating the political settlement of hotspot issues and realizing peace and stability in the region. This demonstrates our commitment, as Global South countries, to seeking strength through unity and upholding fairness and justice. Our two countries are each at a critical stage of development and national {{21}}.
paragraphs.cn: 在1955年万隆会议上，我们两国积极支持反帝反殖斗争，共同推进亚非团结。今天，中埃在维护国际秩序、倡导公平正义、践行多边主义方面拥有共同目标和共同愿望。双方坚定支持巴勒斯坦人民恢复合法民族权利的正义事业，都致力于推动热点问题的政治解决，实现地区和平稳定。这体现了我们作为“全球南方”国家，通过团结寻求力量、维护公平正义的承诺。我们两国都处于发展和民族复兴的关键阶段。

paragraphs.en: China saw its 15th Five-Year Plan for economic and social development getting off to a good start, and is striving to open up new ground in Chinese modernization. Egypt is making vigorous efforts in building the New Republic and forging ahead toward its Vision 2030. The Chinese side is ready to work with the Egyptian side to deepen the comprehensive strategic partnership, advance the building of a community with a shared future between the two countries, and join hands in realizing modernization. We need to enhance mutual trust and serve as a model in carrying forward friendship. The friendship between our two countries was forged by the elder generations of our leaders.
paragraphs.cn: 中国“十五五”规划开局良好，正努力开创中国式现代化新局面。埃及正大力建设“新共和国”，朝着“2030愿景”迈进。中方愿同埃方深化全面战略伙伴关系，推进两国构建命运共同体，携手实现现代化。我们要增进互信，做传承友谊的典范。我们两国之间的友谊是由两国老一辈领导人共同缔造的。

paragraphs.en: It is our honor and responsibility to carry forward, develop and promote this friendship. Our two sides should continue supporting each other on core interests and major concerns, and deepen exchanges and cooperation at various levels and across all sectors to ensure that the baton of friendship is passed on from generation to generation. We need to pursue mutual benefit and win-win cooperation and set a benchmark for joint development. China has the world's largest and most complete industrial system, and is strong in capital, technology and equipment. Egypt has a large population, abundant resources and a vast market.
paragraphs.cn: 传承、发展和弘扬这一友谊是我们的荣幸和责任。双方应继续在核心利益和重大关切问题上相互支持，深化各层级、各领域交流合作，确保友谊的接力棒代代相传。我们要追求互利共赢，树立共同发展的标杆。中国拥有全球规模最大、门类最全的工业体系，在资本、技术和设备方面实力雄厚。埃及人口众多，资源丰富，市场广阔。

paragraphs.en: Our two sides should forge greater {{22}} in development strategies, engage in high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, proactively tap the potential and expand the scope of {{23}} collaboration in a bid to provide sustained impetus to the mutually beneficial cooperation. We need to take pride in who we are while setting an example for exchanges and mutual learning. As two great civilizations, China and Egypt should champion equality, mutual learning, dialogue and {{24}} among civilizations, implement the Global Civilization Initiative, actively protect humanity's cultural heritage, and jointly promote the harmonious coexistence of various civilizations. Our two sides should deepen exchanges and cooperation in areas such as education, tourism, science and technology, health, sports and archaeology, forge a stronger bond of mutual understanding and affinity between our two peoples, with a view to injecting new momentum into the China-Egypt comprehensive strategic partnership, and harnessing the strengths of diverse civilizations to promote the building of a community with a shared future for humanity. We need to press ahead side by side and be pioneers in upholding fairness and justice.
paragraphs.cn: 双方应加强发展战略对接，开展高质量共建“一带一路”合作，积极挖掘潜力，拓展务实合作空间，为互利合作提供持续动力。我们要增强文化自信，做文明互鉴的表率。作为两大文明古国，中埃应倡导文明平等、互鉴、对话、包容，落实全球文明倡议，积极保护人类文化遗产，共同促进不同文明和谐共处。双方应深化教育、旅游、科技、卫生、体育、考古等领域交流合作，增进两国人民相互了解和亲近感，为中埃全面战略伙伴关系注入新动力，发挥不同文明优势，推动构建人类命运共同体。我们要并肩前行，做维护公平正义的先锋。

paragraphs.en: Profound changes unseen in a century are unfolding at a faster pace, amid a {{25}} international landscape. As both major developing countries and important Global South nations, China and Egypt should vigorously uphold world peace and stability, and international fairness and justice by practicing true multilateralism, enhancing multilateral coordination, and working together to deliver on the four global initiatives on development, security, civilization and governance. We need to join hands to lead the way in China-Arab and China-Africa cooperation. As a major country in both the Arab world and Africa, Egypt plays an important role in promoting the collective cooperation between China and Arab states, and between China and African countries. The Chinese side is ready to work with the Egyptian side to enhance the demonstration effect of our well-established cooperation, leverage Egypt's unique location in linking the Arab world and reaching across the African continent, further implement the proposal on building "five cooperation frameworks" between China and Arab states and follow up on the ten partnership actions for modernization between China and Africa.
paragraphs.cn: 百年变局加速演进，国际形势动荡不安。作为重要发展中国家和“全球南方”重要成员，中埃应积极维护世界和平稳定和国际公平正义，践行真正的多边主义，加强多边协调，共同落实全球发展倡议、全球安全倡议、全球文明倡议和全球治理倡议。我们要携手引领中阿、中非合作。埃及作为阿拉伯世界和非洲大国，在促进中国同阿拉伯国家、同非洲国家集体合作方面发挥着重要作用。中方愿同埃方增强成熟合作的示范效应，发挥埃及连接阿拉伯世界、辐射非洲大陆的独特区位优势，进一步落实构建中阿“五大合作格局”的提议，跟进中非现代化“十大伙伴行动”。

paragraphs.en: This will ensure that China-Arab and China-Africa cooperation keeps pace with the times, makes steady progress and goes a long way. For 70 years, China and Egypt have stood by each other rain or shine. Now our two countries are embarking on a new journey with enterprise and fortitude. The Chinese side is ready to work with the Egyptian side to stay true to the shared aspiration of our two countries, build on our past achievements, support each other and forge ahead on the path toward prosperity and rejuvenation, and strive for a better tomorrow in both our respective national development and our bilateral relations.
paragraphs.cn: 这将确保中阿、中非合作与时俱进、稳步推进、行稳致远。七十年来，中埃风雨同舟。如今，我们两国正以昂扬进取的姿态开启新征程。中方愿同埃方一道，坚守两国共同初心，在既往成就基础上，相互支持，携手奋进，朝着繁荣复兴的道路前行，为各自国家发展和双边关系开创更加美好的明天。

Chinese President Xi Jinping on Tuesday published a signed article titled "Celebrating 70 Years of Solidarity, China and Egypt Embark on a New Journey" in Al-Ahram, Al-Akhbar and Al-Gomhuria ahead of his arrival in Egypt for a state visit.
The following is the full text of the article:
H.E. Xi Jinping
President of the People's Republic of China
At the invitation of His Excellency President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi, I will be paying a state visit to Egypt and, as President of the People's Republic of China, setting foot for the second time on this land nourished by the Nile. Just as an Egyptian proverb reads, "Once you drink from the Nile, you are destined to return." During my last visit ten years ago, I was deeply impressed by the time-honored, profound civilization of this country, together with its booming vitality and upward momentum. This time, I look forward to renewing the friendship and working together with President El-Sisi to explore ways of cooperation and map out a new blueprint for deepening the China-Egypt comprehensive strategic partnership.
As a Chinese saying goes, "A partnership forged with the right approach defies distance." Known for their age-old civilizations, China and Egypt have each contributed an invaluable intellectual legacy and splendid cultural heritage to the progress of humanity. The Yangtze River and the Yellow River gave birth to the Chinese civilization, and the Nile was the cradle of the ancient Egyptian civilization. With porcelain and silk sailing the seas and traversing the deserts, the vast geographical distance never kept our two civilizations from appreciating each other, and friendly exchanges along the millennium-old ancient Silk Road never stopped. Chinese silk, porcelain, and paper-making, smelting and casting techniques made their way westward, while Egyptian aromatics, glassware and calendrical knowledge journeyed over thousands of miles eastward. The Chinese artifacts unearthed in Fustat attest to the close bonds and deep friendship that have existed between our peoples since ancient times.
Seventy years ago, China and Egypt officially established diplomatic relations, marking the start of New China's friendly cooperation with Arab and African countries. For seven decades, the China-Egypt relationship has braved wind and rain, and withstood the test of the changing international landscape. It has stayed on the right course, remained robust as ever, and sustained a strong momentum. It is a fine example for China's cooperation with Arab states and Africa on the whole, and for friendship, solidarity and collaboration between developing countries.
— China and Egypt have always been close brothers standing by each other. In the struggle for national independence and against imperialism and colonialism, the people of our two countries forged profound friendship. China firmly supported Egypt's sovereignty over the Suez Canal, and Egypt, alongside the majority of Asian, African, and Latin American and Caribbean countries, voted unequivocally in favor of the restoration of the lawful seat of the People's Republic of China in the United Nations. Currently, our two sides firmly support each other in pursuing development paths suited to our respective national conditions, and firmly support each other on core interests and major concerns. All this has laid a solid foundation for the China-Egypt comprehensive strategic partnership.
— China and Egypt have always been reliable partners in win-win cooperation. Egypt is China's major trading and investment partner in the Arab world and Africa, and one of the first countries to participate in Belt and Road cooperation. As early as ten years ago, President El-Sisi and I jointly unveiled the China-Egypt Suez Economic and Trade Cooperation Zone. The project has drawn substantial investment, created a large number of local jobs, and helped in Egypt's endeavor to expedite its modernization. In other fields, fruits of mutually beneficial cooperation -- from Africa's tallest building and first intercity electric light rail built in Egypt by Chinese enterprises, to fresh Egyptian oranges heading for the Chinese market as the first African produce to capitalize on China's zero-tariff policy for the African countries having diplomatic relations with it -- are shared by countless households in both countries.
— China and Egypt have always been the role models of friendship and mutual learning. Egypt is the first among both Arab nations and African countries to sign an agreement on cultural cooperation with New China, and our people-to-people exchanges have been diverse and vibrant. The Grand Egyptian Museum is a must-visit for Chinese tourists, so much so that the exhibition "The Civilization of Ancient Egypt" in Shanghai Museum saw tickets sell out in seconds. In Egypt, the Chinese language is taught in more than 40 middle schools, and cooperation with China on vocational education has benefited numerous Egyptians. Across time and space, the two civilizations have been reaching out to each other, adding new chapters of everlasting friendship between the two peoples.
— China and Egypt have always been sincere friends committed to equality and mutual trust. At the Bandung Conference in 1955, our two countries actively supported the anti-imperial and anti-colonial struggle, and jointly advanced Asian-African solidarity. Today, China and Egypt have shared goals and common aspiration in upholding international order, championing fairness and justice, and practicing multilateralism. Both sides firmly support the just cause of the Palestinian people in restoring their legitimate national rights, and both are committed to facilitating the political settlement of hotspot issues and realizing peace and stability in the region. This demonstrates our commitment, as Global South countries, to seeking strength through unity and upholding fairness and justice.
Our two countries are each at a critical stage of development and national revitalization. China saw its 15th Five-Year Plan for economic and social development getting off to a good start, and is striving to open up new ground in Chinese modernization. Egypt is making vigorous efforts in building the New Republic and forging ahead toward its Vision 2030. The Chinese side is ready to work with the Egyptian side to deepen the comprehensive strategic partnership, advance the building of a community with a shared future between the two countries, and join hands in realizing modernization.
We need to enhance mutual trust and serve as a model in carrying forward friendship. The friendship between our two countries was forged by the elder generations of our leaders. It is our honor and responsibility to carry forward, develop and promote this friendship. Our two sides should continue supporting each other on core interests and major concerns, and deepen exchanges and cooperation at various levels and across all sectors to ensure that the baton of friendship is passed on from generation to generation.
We need to pursue mutual benefit and win-win cooperation and set a benchmark for joint development. China has the world's largest and most complete industrial system, and is strong in capital, technology and equipment. Egypt has a large population, abundant resources and a vast market. Our two sides should forge greater synergy in development strategies, engage in high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, proactively tap the potential and expand the scope of pragmatic collaboration in a bid to provide sustained impetus to the mutually beneficial cooperation.
We need to take pride in who we are while setting an example for exchanges and mutual learning. As two great civilizations, China and Egypt should champion equality, mutual learning, dialogue and inclusiveness among civilizations, implement the Global Civilization Initiative, actively protect humanity's cultural heritage, and jointly promote the harmonious coexistence of various civilizations. Our two sides should deepen exchanges and cooperation in areas such as education, tourism, science and technology, health, sports and archaeology, forge a stronger bond of mutual understanding and affinity between our two peoples, with a view to injecting new momentum into the China-Egypt comprehensive strategic partnership, and harnessing the strengths of diverse civilizations to promote the building of a community with a shared future for humanity.
We need to press ahead side by side and be pioneers in upholding fairness and justice. Profound changes unseen in a century are unfolding at a faster pace, amid a volatile international landscape. As both major developing countries and important Global South nations, China and Egypt should vigorously uphold world peace and stability, and international fairness and justice by practicing true multilateralism, enhancing multilateral coordination, and working together to deliver on the four global initiatives on development, security, civilization and governance.
We need to join hands to lead the way in China-Arab and China-Africa cooperation. As a major country in both the Arab world and Africa, Egypt plays an important role in promoting the collective cooperation between China and Arab states, and between China and African countries. The Chinese side is ready to work with the Egyptian side to enhance the demonstration effect of our well-established cooperation, leverage Egypt's unique location in linking the Arab world and reaching across the African continent, further implement the proposal on building "five cooperation frameworks" between China and Arab states and follow up on the ten partnership actions for modernization between China and Africa. This will ensure that China-Arab and China-Africa cooperation keeps pace with the times, makes steady progress and goes a long way.
For 70 years, China and Egypt have stood by each other rain or shine. Now our two countries are embarking on a new journey with enterprise and fortitude. The Chinese side is ready to work with the Egyptian side to stay true to the shared aspiration of our two countries, build on our past achievements, support each other and forge ahead on the path toward prosperity and rejuvenation, and strive for a better tomorrow in both our respective national development and our bilateral relations.

中国国家主席习近平在抵达埃及进行国事访问前夕，于周二在《金字塔报》、《消息报》和《共和国报》发表了题为《庆祝中埃建交70周年，携手开启新征程》的署名文章。以下是文章全文：中华人民共和国主席习近平应阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西总统阁下邀请，我将对埃及进行国事访问，并以中华人民共和国主席的身份第二次踏上这片由尼罗河滋养的土地。正如埃及谚语所说：“喝了尼罗河的水，注定还会回来。”十年前我上次访问时，这个国家悠久深厚的文明、蓬勃的活力和向上的势头给我留下了深刻印象。此次，我期待与塞西总统重温友谊，共同探讨合作途径，为深化中埃全面战略伙伴关系绘制新蓝图。

中国有句古话：“志合者，不以山海为远。”中埃两国都以古老文明著称，各自为人类进步贡献了宝贵的思想遗产和灿烂的文化瑰宝。长江和黄河孕育了中华文明，尼罗河则是古埃及文明的摇篮。瓷器与丝绸漂洋过海、穿越沙漠，广阔的地理距离从未阻碍我们两大文明相互欣赏，千年古丝绸之路上的友好交往从未中断。中国的丝绸、瓷器、造纸、冶炼和铸造技术西传，而埃及的香料、玻璃器皿和历法知识则东行数千英里。在福斯塔特出土的中国文物见证了中埃人民自古以来就存在的紧密联系和深厚友谊。

七十年前，中埃正式建立外交关系，标志着新中国与阿拉伯和非洲国家友好合作的开端。七十年来，中埃关系历经风雨，经受住了国际风云变幻的考验，始终沿着正确方向前进，保持强劲势头。它是中国同阿拉伯国家和非洲整体合作的典范，也是发展中国家友好团结协作的典范。——中埃始终是守望相助的亲密兄弟。

在争取民族独立、反对帝国主义和殖民主义的斗争中，两国人民结下了深厚友谊。中国坚定支持埃及对苏伊士运河的主权，埃及同广大亚洲、非洲、拉丁美洲和加勒比国家一道，明确投票赞成恢复中华人民共和国在联合国的合法席位。当前，双方坚定支持彼此探索符合本国国情的发展道路，在核心利益和重大关切问题上坚定相互支持。所有这些都为中埃全面战略伙伴关系奠定了坚实基础。——中埃始终是互利共赢的可靠伙伴。

埃及是中国在阿拉伯世界和非洲的主要贸易和投资伙伴，也是最早参与“一带一路”合作的国家之一。早在十年前，塞西总统和我共同启动了中埃苏伊士经贸合作区。该项目吸引了大量投资，创造了大量本地就业机会，助力埃及加快现代化进程。在其他领域，互利合作的成果——从中国企业承建的非洲最高建筑和首条城际电气化轻轨，到作为首个受益于中国对建交非洲国家零关税政策的非洲农产品、新鲜埃及橙子进入中国市场——惠及两国千家万户。——中埃始终是友好互鉴的典范。

埃及是第一个同新中国签署文化合作协定的阿拉伯和非洲国家，我们的人文交流丰富多彩。大埃及博物馆是中国游客的必访之地，以至于上海博物馆的“古埃及文明大展”门票数秒内售罄。在埃及，超过40所中学教授中文，与中国的职业教育合作惠及众多埃及民众。跨越时空，两大文明相互走近，为中埃人民之间的永恒友谊增添了新篇章。——中埃始终是平等互信的真诚朋友。

在1955年万隆会议上，我们两国积极支持反帝反殖斗争，共同推进亚非团结。今天，中埃在维护国际秩序、倡导公平正义、践行多边主义方面拥有共同目标和共同愿望。双方坚定支持巴勒斯坦人民恢复合法民族权利的正义事业，都致力于推动热点问题的政治解决，实现地区和平稳定。这体现了我们作为“全球南方”国家，通过团结寻求力量、维护公平正义的承诺。我们两国都处于发展和民族复兴的关键阶段。

中国“十五五”规划开局良好，正努力开创中国式现代化新局面。埃及正大力建设“新共和国”，朝着“2030愿景”迈进。中方愿同埃方深化全面战略伙伴关系，推进两国构建命运共同体，携手实现现代化。我们要增进互信，做传承友谊的典范。我们两国之间的友谊是由两国老一辈领导人共同缔造的。

传承、发展和弘扬这一友谊是我们的荣幸和责任。双方应继续在核心利益和重大关切问题上相互支持，深化各层级、各领域交流合作，确保友谊的接力棒代代相传。我们要追求互利共赢，树立共同发展的标杆。中国拥有全球规模最大、门类最全的工业体系，在资本、技术和设备方面实力雄厚。埃及人口众多，资源丰富，市场广阔。

双方应加强发展战略对接，开展高质量共建“一带一路”合作，积极挖掘潜力，拓展务实合作空间，为互利合作提供持续动力。我们要增强文化自信，做文明互鉴的表率。作为两大文明古国，中埃应倡导文明平等、互鉴、对话、包容，落实全球文明倡议，积极保护人类文化遗产，共同促进不同文明和谐共处。双方应深化教育、旅游、科技、卫生、体育、考古等领域交流合作，增进两国人民相互了解和亲近感，为中埃全面战略伙伴关系注入新动力，发挥不同文明优势，推动构建人类命运共同体。我们要并肩前行，做维护公平正义的先锋。

百年变局加速演进，国际形势动荡不安。作为重要发展中国家和“全球南方”重要成员，中埃应积极维护世界和平稳定和国际公平正义，践行真正的多边主义，加强多边协调，共同落实全球发展倡议、全球安全倡议、全球文明倡议和全球治理倡议。我们要携手引领中阿、中非合作。埃及作为阿拉伯世界和非洲大国，在促进中国同阿拉伯国家、同非洲国家集体合作方面发挥着重要作用。中方愿同埃方增强成熟合作的示范效应，发挥埃及连接阿拉伯世界、辐射非洲大陆的独特区位优势，进一步落实构建中阿“五大合作格局”的提议，跟进中非现代化“十大伙伴行动”。

这将确保中阿、中非合作与时俱进、稳步推进、行稳致远。七十年来，中埃风雨同舟。如今，我们两国正以昂扬进取的姿态开启新征程。中方愿同埃方一道，坚守两国共同初心，在既往成就基础上，相互支持，携手奋进，朝着繁荣复兴的道路前行，为各自国家发展和双边关系开创更加美好的明天。

articles.title: Xi, Japarov chart new course for China-Kyrgyzstan ties
articles.titleCn: 习近平与扎帕罗夫共绘中吉关系新蓝图
articles.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping said on Monday that China stands ready to work with Kyrgyzstan to better align development strategies, deepen exchanges of experience in governance, deliver more tangible and accessible outcomes through practical cooperation, and make substantive progress in building a China-Kyrgyzstan community with a shared future.
articles.summaryCn: 习近平访问吉尔吉斯斯坦，双方同意深化战略伙伴关系，签署永久睦邻友好合作条约，并推动多领域合作。

paragraphs.en:

paragraphs.cn: 中国国家主席习近平于2026年8月31日在吉尔吉斯斯坦首都比什凯克与吉尔吉斯总统萨德尔·扎帕罗夫握手。/新华社

paragraphs.en:
Deepening trust, building a shared future
The visit coincides with the 35th anniversary of Kyrgyzstan's independence. On behalf of the Chinese government and people, Xi first extended greetings to Japarov on the occasion of Kyrgyzstan's Independence Day. Xi said that in recent years, China-Kyrgyzstan relations have achieved {{4}} development under the joint guidance of the two leaders, with cooperation across all fields {{5}}, boosting the development of both countries and bringing benefits to their people, while also contributing to peace, stability and {{6}} in the region. Xi noted that this year marks the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and the launch of China's 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030). China is building a great country in all respects and advancing the great {{7}} of the Chinese nation on all fronts through Chinese modernization, Xi said, noting that Kyrgyzstan is also making every effort to implement its National Development Program until 2030.
paragraphs.cn: 中国国家主席习近平周一表示，中国愿与吉尔吉斯斯坦合作，提供更多切实可及的实际合作成果。习近平在与吉尔吉斯总统萨德尔·扎帕罗夫会谈时发表上述讲话。习近平于周日抵达比什凯克，对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问并出席上海合作组织2026年峰会。此次访问正值中吉合作进入快速发展“黄金时期”，习近平在抵达时发表的书面讲话中指出，两国正致力于将长期友谊和牢固的政治互信转化为更广泛的合作和更多的人民福祉。

paragraphs.en: China stands ready to work with Kyrgyzstan to strengthen the alignment of development strategies, deepen exchanges on governance experience and make {{8}} progress in building a China-Kyrgyzstan community with a shared future, he added. Xi noted that high-level political mutual trust and firm mutual support are crucial to ensuring the steady and sustained development of China-Kyrgyzstan relations. China firmly supports Kyrgyzstan in safeguarding its national {{9}}, independence and {{10}} integrity, as well as pursuing a development path suited to its national conditions, Xi said, adding that China stands ready to work with the Kyrgyz side to continue firmly supporting each other on issues involving each other's core interests. For his part, Japarov said he was honored to welcome Xi to Kyrgyzstan on the occasion of the 35th anniversary of the country's independence. The visit further demonstrated the profound friendship and high-level political mutual trust between Kyrgyzstan and China, and marked an important {{11}} in the history of bilateral relations, he said.
paragraphs.cn: 深化互信，共建未来

paragraphs.en:
Japarov said Kyrgyzstan and China are neighboring countries, and the ancient Silk Road has closely connected the two nations. In recent years, with the rapid development of the Kyrgyzstan-China comprehensive strategic partnership for a new era, bilateral relations have entered a golden period and reached an {{12}} level, he said. He expressed gratitude to China for its {{13}} support and assistance at every critical moment in Kyrgyzstan's development, while extending warm congratulations on the 105th anniversary of the founding of the CPC and the launch of the implementation of China's 15th Five-Year Plan. Japarov also expressed {{14}} for the remarkable development achievements China has made under the leadership of Xi and voiced willingness to learn from China's experience in state governance, particularly Xi's commitment to the people, as {{15}} in his words, "I will fully commit to the people and never fail them."
China has always been a {{16}} in Kyrgyzstan's foreign policy, as well as Kyrgyzstan's closest friend and most reliable partner, Japarov said, noting that Kyrgyzstan firmly adheres to the one-China principle and stands ready to further develop good-neighborly and friendly relations with China on the basis of mutual respect, equality and mutual benefit. Chinese President Xi Jinping, accompanied by Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, inspects the guard of honor during a welcome ceremony in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, August 31, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 此次访问恰逢吉尔吉斯斯坦独立35周年。习近平首先代表中国政府和人民，向扎帕罗夫致以吉尔吉斯斯坦独立日的祝贺。习近平表示，近年来，中吉关系在两国领导人共同引领下实现跨越式发展，各领域合作蓬勃发展，促进了两国发展，造福了两国人民，也为地区和平、稳定与繁荣作出了贡献。习近平指出，今年是中国共产党成立105周年，也是中国“十五五”规划（2026-2030年）开局之年。习近平表示，中国正在全面推进强国建设、民族复兴伟业，通过中国式现代化全方位推进中华民族伟大复兴，而吉尔吉斯斯坦也在全力落实其2030年前国家发展规划。

paragraphs.en:
/Xinhua
Expanding practical cooperation, delivering tangible benefits
Xi urged the two countries to deepen practical cooperation, effectively implement the intergovernmental economic and trade cooperation plan, {{17}} trade products and develop new growth areas such as digital trade and cross-border e-commerce. Xi also said the two sides should ensure the high-quality construction of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway, calling it a major transportation {{18}} that carries the development {{19}} of the people across the region. He called for modernizing border ports and deepening "soft connectivity" in institutions, standards and rules, and urged the launch of more {{20}} projects in renewable energy, resource recycling and other fields, the implementation of cooperation documents on green minerals and cooperation across the entire industrial chain. Xi said China and Kyrgyzstan should make joint efforts to successfully build the Belt and Road Joint Laboratory, enhance artificial intelligence cooperation and {{21}} scientific and technological innovation to boost the quality and efficiency of bilateral cooperation. The two sides should further {{22}} exchanges and expand cooperation in youth affairs, media, tourism, sports, health care and local affairs, while continuing to strengthen the social and public support for China-Kyrgyzstan friendship, Xi added.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平补充说，中国愿与吉尔吉斯斯坦加强发展战略对接，深化治国理政经验交流，在构建中吉命运共同体方面取得实质性进展。习近平指出，高水平政治互信和坚定相互支持是确保中吉关系稳定持续发展的关键。习近平说，中国坚定支持吉尔吉斯斯坦维护国家主权、独立和领土完整，支持其走符合本国国情的发展道路，并强调中国愿与吉方继续在涉及彼此核心利益的问题上坚定相互支持。扎帕罗夫表示，很荣幸在吉尔吉斯斯坦独立35周年之际欢迎习近平到访。他说，此次访问进一步体现了吉中两国深厚的友谊和高水平的政治互信，是双边关系史上的重要里程碑。

paragraphs.en:
For his part, Japarov said Kyrgyzstan is willing to strengthen cooperation with China in trade and investment, connectivity, technological innovation, energy, mineral resources and the green economy, as well as deepen exchanges in education, health, culture and youth sectors. Kyrgyzstan is ready to actively advance the construction of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway, so as to turn it into a "steel Silk Road" for the new era and a new bond of friendship between the two countries, Japarov said. Chinese President Xi Jinping holds talks with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, August 31, 2026. /Xinhua
Joining hands for peace and development
China and Kyrgyzstan should expand cooperation in law enforcement and security, work together to {{23}} the "three evil forces" of terrorism, extremism and separatism, drug trafficking and transnational crimes, and jointly maintain regional peace and stability, Xi said. China supports Kyrgyzstan in playing a greater role in international and regional affairs, Xi said, noting that China is willing to further enhance collaboration with Kyrgyzstan within the framework of the United Nations, jointly implement the four major global initiatives, oppose {{24}} and power politics, adhere to true multilateralism, safeguard international fairness and justice, and promote the building of a more just and equitable global governance system.
paragraphs.cn: 扎帕罗夫表示，吉尔吉斯斯坦和中国是邻国，古老的丝绸之路将两国紧密相连。他说，近年来，随着吉中新时代全面战略伙伴关系的快速发展，双边关系进入黄金时期，达到前所未有的水平。他对中国在吉尔吉斯斯坦发展每个关键时刻给予的无私支持和帮助表示感谢，并对中国共产党成立105周年和中国“十五五”规划启动实施表示热烈祝贺。扎帕罗夫还对中国在习近平领导下取得的显著发展成就表示钦佩，并表示愿意学习中国的治国理政经验，特别是习近平对人民的承诺，正如他所说：“我将无我，不负人民。”

paragraphs.en: Noting that China and Kyrgyzstan are both founding members of the SCO, Xi said the two countries should promote the implementation of the outcomes of the Tianjin Summit, facilitate common development in the region and advance the development of the SCO to a new level. For his part, Japarov said that the four global initiatives proposed by Xi help countries work together to address common challenges and build a more just and stable international order. Kyrgyzstan stands ready to closely coordinate with China on multilateral platforms, including the United Nations, the SCO, the China-Central Asia mechanism and the World AI Cooperation Organization, to jointly safeguard world peace and stability, Japarov said. Following the talks, the two heads of state signed a joint declaration of the People's Republic of China and the Kyrgyz Republic on the high-quality development of the comprehensive strategic partnership for a new era and a bilateral treaty on permanent good-neighborliness, friendship and cooperation. The signing of the bilateral treaty on permanent good-neighborliness, friendship and cooperation will provide an important legal foundation for the everlasting friendship and firm mutual support between the two countries, Xi said.
paragraphs.cn: 扎帕罗夫表示，中国始终是吉尔吉斯斯坦外交政策的优先方向，也是吉尔吉斯斯坦最亲密的朋友和最可靠的伙伴。吉尔吉斯斯坦坚定恪守一个中国原则，愿在相互尊重、平等互利的基础上进一步发展对华睦邻友好关系。中国国家主席习近平在吉尔吉斯总统萨德尔·扎帕罗夫的陪同下，于2026年8月31日在比什凯克检阅仪仗队。

paragraphs.en: Echoing Xi, Japarov said the signing of the treaty will open up broader prospects for bilateral relations. They also jointly witnessed the exchange of bilateral cooperation documents in the fields of investment, transportation, customs and sister-city relations. During the visit, the two sides also signed over 20 cooperation documents covering science and technology, education, culture, media and other areas.
paragraphs.cn: /新华社

articles.fullText:
Chinese President Xi Jinping shakes hands with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov in Bishkek, the capital of Kyrgyzstan, August 31, 2026. /Xinhua
Chinese President Xi Jinping said on Monday that China stands ready to work with Kyrgyzstan to deliver more practical cooperation outcomes that are tangible and accessible.
Xi made the remarks during talks with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov. Xi landed in Bishkek on Sunday for a state visit to Kyrgyzstan and to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) Summit 2026.
The visit came as the China-Kyrgyzstan cooperation has ushered in a "golden period" of rapid development, as noted by Xi in a written speech delivered upon his arrival, with the two countries working to translate their longstanding friendship and strong political mutual trust into broader cooperation and greater benefits for their people.
Deepening trust, building a shared future
The visit coincides with the 35th anniversary of Kyrgyzstan's independence. On behalf of the Chinese government and people, Xi first extended greetings to Japarov on the occasion of Kyrgyzstan's Independence Day.
Xi said that in recent years, China-Kyrgyzstan relations have achieved leapfrog development under the joint guidance of the two leaders, with cooperation across all fields flourishing, boosting the development of both countries and bringing benefits to their people, while also contributing to peace, stability and prosperity in the region.
Xi noted that this year marks the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and the launch of China's 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030).
China is building a great country in all respects and advancing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation on all fronts through Chinese modernization, Xi said, noting that Kyrgyzstan is also making every effort to implement its National Development Program until 2030.
China stands ready to work with Kyrgyzstan to strengthen the alignment of development strategies, deepen exchanges on governance experience and make substantive progress in building a China-Kyrgyzstan community with a shared future, he added.
Xi noted that high-level political mutual trust and firm mutual support are crucial to ensuring the steady and sustained development of China-Kyrgyzstan relations.
China firmly supports Kyrgyzstan in safeguarding its national sovereignty, independence and territorial integrity, as well as pursuing a development path suited to its national conditions, Xi said, adding that China stands ready to work with the Kyrgyz side to continue firmly supporting each other on issues involving each other's core interests.
For his part, Japarov said he was honored to welcome Xi to Kyrgyzstan on the occasion of the 35th anniversary of the country's independence. The visit further demonstrated the profound friendship and high-level political mutual trust between Kyrgyzstan and China, and marked an important milestone in the history of bilateral relations, he said.
Japarov said Kyrgyzstan and China are neighboring countries, and the ancient Silk Road has closely connected the two nations. In recent years, with the rapid development of the Kyrgyzstan-China comprehensive strategic partnership for a new era, bilateral relations have entered a golden period and reached an unprecedented level, he said.
He expressed gratitude to China for its selfless support and assistance at every critical moment in Kyrgyzstan's development, while extending warm congratulations on the 105th anniversary of the founding of the CPC and the launch of the implementation of China's 15th Five-Year Plan.
Japarov also expressed admiration for the remarkable development achievements China has made under the leadership of Xi and voiced willingness to learn from China's experience in state governance, particularly Xi's commitment to the people, as embodied in his words, "I will fully commit to the people and never fail them."
China has always been a priority in Kyrgyzstan's foreign policy, as well as Kyrgyzstan's closest friend and most reliable partner, Japarov said, noting that Kyrgyzstan firmly adheres to the one-China principle and stands ready to further develop good-neighborly and friendly relations with China on the basis of mutual respect, equality and mutual benefit.
Chinese President Xi Jinping, accompanied by Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, inspects the guard of honor during a welcome ceremony in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, August 31, 2026. /Xinhua
Expanding practical cooperation, delivering tangible benefits
Xi urged the two countries to deepen practical cooperation, effectively implement the intergovernmental economic and trade cooperation plan, diversify trade products and develop new growth areas such as digital trade and cross-border e-commerce.
Xi also said the two sides should ensure the high-quality construction of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway, calling it a major transportation artery that carries the development aspirations of the people across the region.
He called for modernizing border ports and deepening "soft connectivity" in institutions, standards and rules, and urged the launch of more landmark projects in renewable energy, resource recycling and other fields, the implementation of cooperation documents on green minerals and cooperation across the entire industrial chain.
Xi said China and Kyrgyzstan should make joint efforts to successfully build the Belt and Road Joint Laboratory, enhance artificial intelligence cooperation and leverage scientific and technological innovation to boost the quality and efficiency of bilateral cooperation.
The two sides should further facilitate exchanges and expand cooperation in youth affairs, media, tourism, sports, health care and local affairs, while continuing to strengthen the social and public support for China-Kyrgyzstan friendship, Xi added.
For his part, Japarov said Kyrgyzstan is willing to strengthen cooperation with China in trade and investment, connectivity, technological innovation, energy, mineral resources and the green economy, as well as deepen exchanges in education, health, culture and youth sectors.
Kyrgyzstan is ready to actively advance the construction of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway, so as to turn it into a "steel Silk Road" for the new era and a new bond of friendship between the two countries, Japarov said.
Chinese President Xi Jinping holds talks with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, August 31, 2026. /Xinhua
Joining hands for peace and development
China and Kyrgyzstan should expand cooperation in law enforcement and security, work together to combat the "three evil forces" of terrorism, extremism and separatism, drug trafficking and transnational crimes, and jointly maintain regional peace and stability, Xi said.
China supports Kyrgyzstan in playing a greater role in international and regional affairs, Xi said, noting that China is willing to further enhance collaboration with Kyrgyzstan within the framework of the United Nations, jointly implement the four major global initiatives, oppose hegemonism and power politics, adhere to true multilateralism, safeguard international fairness and justice, and promote the building of a more just and equitable global governance system.
Noting that China and Kyrgyzstan are both founding members of the SCO, Xi said the two countries should promote the implementation of the outcomes of the Tianjin Summit, facilitate common development in the region and advance the development of the SCO to a new level.
For his part, Japarov said that the four global initiatives proposed by Xi help countries work together to address common challenges and build a more just and stable international order.
Kyrgyzstan stands ready to closely coordinate with China on multilateral platforms, including the United Nations, the SCO, the China-Central Asia mechanism and the World AI Cooperation Organization, to jointly safeguard world peace and stability, Japarov said.
Following the talks, the two heads of state signed a joint declaration of the People's Republic of China and the Kyrgyz Republic on the high-quality development of the comprehensive strategic partnership for a new era and a bilateral treaty on permanent good-neighborliness, friendship and cooperation.
The signing of the bilateral treaty on permanent good-neighborliness, friendship and cooperation will provide an important legal foundation for the everlasting friendship and firm mutual support between the two countries, Xi said.
Echoing Xi, Japarov said the signing of the treaty will open up broader prospects for bilateral relations.
They also jointly witnessed the exchange of bilateral cooperation documents in the fields of investment, transportation, customs and sister-city relations.
During the visit, the two sides also signed over 20 cooperation documents covering science and technology, education, culture, media and other areas.

中国国家主席习近平于2026年8月31日在吉尔吉斯斯坦首都比什凯克与吉尔吉斯总统萨德尔·扎帕罗夫握手。/新华社

中国国家主席习近平周一表示，中国愿与吉尔吉斯斯坦合作，提供更多切实可及的实际合作成果。习近平在与吉尔吉斯总统萨德尔·扎帕罗夫会谈时发表上述讲话。习近平于周日抵达比什凯克，对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问并出席上海合作组织2026年峰会。此次访问正值中吉合作进入快速发展“黄金时期”，习近平在抵达时发表的书面讲话中指出，两国正致力于将长期友谊和牢固的政治互信转化为更广泛的合作和更多的人民福祉。

深化互信，共建未来

此次访问恰逢吉尔吉斯斯坦独立35周年。习近平首先代表中国政府和人民，向扎帕罗夫致以吉尔吉斯斯坦独立日的祝贺。习近平表示，近年来，中吉关系在两国领导人共同引领下实现跨越式发展，各领域合作蓬勃发展，促进了两国发展，造福了两国人民，也为地区和平、稳定与繁荣作出了贡献。习近平指出，今年是中国共产党成立105周年，也是中国“十五五”规划（2026-2030年）开局之年。习近平表示，中国正在全面推进强国建设、民族复兴伟业，通过中国式现代化全方位推进中华民族伟大复兴，而吉尔吉斯斯坦也在全力落实其2030年前国家发展规划。

习近平补充说，中国愿与吉尔吉斯斯坦加强发展战略对接，深化治国理政经验交流，在构建中吉命运共同体方面取得实质性进展。习近平指出，高水平政治互信和坚定相互支持是确保中吉关系稳定持续发展的关键。习近平说，中国坚定支持吉尔吉斯斯坦维护国家主权、独立和领土完整，支持其走符合本国国情的发展道路，并强调中国愿与吉方继续在涉及彼此核心利益的问题上坚定相互支持。扎帕罗夫表示，很荣幸在吉尔吉斯斯坦独立35周年之际欢迎习近平到访。他说，此次访问进一步体现了吉中两国深厚的友谊和高水平的政治互信，是双边关系史上的重要里程碑。

扎帕罗夫表示，吉尔吉斯斯坦和中国是邻国，古老的丝绸之路将两国紧密相连。他说，近年来，随着吉中新时代全面战略伙伴关系的快速发展，双边关系进入黄金时期，达到前所未有的水平。他对中国在吉尔吉斯斯坦发展每个关键时刻给予的无私支持和帮助表示感谢，并对中国共产党成立105周年和中国“十五五”规划启动实施表示热烈祝贺。扎帕罗夫还对中国在习近平领导下取得的显著发展成就表示钦佩，并表示愿意学习中国的治国理政经验，特别是习近平对人民的承诺，正如他所说：“我将无我，不负人民。”

扎帕罗夫表示，中国始终是吉尔吉斯斯坦外交政策的优先方向，也是吉尔吉斯斯坦最亲密的朋友和最可靠的伙伴。吉尔吉斯斯坦坚定恪守一个中国原则，愿在相互尊重、平等互利的基础上进一步发展对华睦邻友好关系。中国国家主席习近平在吉尔吉斯总统萨德尔·扎帕罗夫的陪同下，于2026年8月31日在比什凯克检阅仪仗队。

/新华社

扩大务实合作，带来实实在在的利益

习近平敦促两国深化务实合作，有效落实政府间经贸合作规划，丰富贸易产品，发展数字贸易和跨境电商等新增长点。习近平还表示，双方应确保中吉乌铁路高质量建设，称其为承载地区人民发展愿望的重大交通动脉。他呼吁推进边境口岸现代化，深化机构、标准和规则方面的“软联通”，并敦促在可再生能源、资源回收等领域启动更多标志性项目，落实绿色矿产合作文件和全产业链合作。习近平表示，中吉应共同努力，成功建设“一带一路”联合实验室，加强人工智能合作，以科技创新提升双边合作质量和效率。习近平补充说，双方应进一步便利人员往来，扩大青年、媒体、旅游、体育、卫生和地方事务合作，同时继续夯实中吉友好的社会和民意基础。

扎帕罗夫表示，吉尔吉斯斯坦愿与中国加强在贸易投资、互联互通、科技创新、能源、矿产资源、绿色经济等领域的合作，深化教育、卫生、文化和青年领域交流。吉尔吉斯斯坦愿积极推进中吉乌铁路建设，将其打造为新时代的“钢铁丝路”和两国友谊的新纽带，扎帕罗夫说。中国国家主席习近平于2026年8月31日在比什凯克与吉尔吉斯总统萨德尔·扎帕罗夫举行会谈。/新华社

携手促进和平与发展

习近平表示，中吉应扩大执法和安全合作，共同打击恐怖主义、极端主义、分裂主义“三股势力”、毒品贩运和跨国犯罪，共同维护地区和平稳定。习近平表示，中国支持吉尔吉斯斯坦在国际和地区事务中发挥更大作用，并指出中国愿在联合国框架内加强与吉尔吉斯斯坦的协作，共同落实四大全球倡议，反对霸权主义和强权政治，坚持真正的多边主义，维护国际公平正义，推动构建更加公正合理的全球治理体系。

习近平指出，中吉都是上合组织创始成员国，双方应推动落实天津峰会成果，促进地区共同发展，推动上合组织发展迈上新台阶。扎帕罗夫表示，习近平提出的四大全球倡议有助于各国共同应对挑战，构建更加公正稳定的国际秩序。吉尔吉斯斯坦愿在联合国、上合组织、中国-中亚机制和世界人工智能合作组织等多边平台上与中方密切协调，共同维护世界和平与稳定，扎帕罗夫说。会谈后，两国元首签署了《中华人民共和国和吉尔吉斯共和国关于新时代全面战略伙伴关系高质量发展的联合声明》和《中华人民共和国和吉尔吉斯共和国关于永久睦邻友好合作条约》。习近平表示，签署永久睦邻友好合作条约将为两国世代友好和坚定相互支持提供重要法律基础。

扎帕罗夫呼应习近平表示，条约的签署将为双边关系开辟更广阔前景。他们还共同见证了投资、交通、海关和友好城市等领域双边合作文件的交换。访问期间，双方还签署了涵盖科技、教育、文化、媒体等领域的20多项合作文件。

paragraphs.en: * China is ready to work with all parties to continue to {{0}} for higher quality development, and make the global governance system more just and {{1}}, Chinese President Xi Jinping said on Tuesday during the 26th Meeting of the Council of Heads of State of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) and the "SCO Plus" meeting. * At the crossroads concerning the future of humanity, the SCO should {{2}} its historic responsibility and take the {{3}} in {{4}} the course of history, he said. * At the "SCO Plus" meeting, Xi called on the SCO to shoulder the responsibility of the times and work together to advance a more just and equitable global governance system, as well as an equal and orderly multipolar world. Chinese President Xi Jinping said on Tuesday that China is ready to work with all parties to continue to strive for higher quality development, and make the global governance system more just and equitable. Xi made the remarks in his speeches at the 26th Meeting of the Council of Heads of State of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) and the "SCO Plus" meeting held in the Kyrgyz capital of Bishkek.
paragraphs.cn: 中国国家主席习近平周二在上海合作组织成员国元首理事会第二十六次会议和“上合+”会议上表示，中国愿与各方一道，继续努力实现更高质量发展，推动全球治理体系更加公正合理。在关乎人类未来的十字路口，上合组织应肩负起历史责任，主动引领历史进程。在“上合+”会议上，习近平呼吁上合组织肩负起时代责任，共同推动更加公正合理的全球治理体系，以及平等有序的多极世界。中国国家主席习近平周二表示，中国愿与各方一道，继续努力实现更高质量发展，推动全球治理体系更加公正合理。习近平是在吉尔吉斯斯坦首都比什凯克举行的上海合作组织成员国元首理事会第二十六次会议和“上合+”会议上发表讲话时作出上述表示的。

paragraphs.en: This year marks the 25th founding anniversary of the SCO. Xi said that over the past 25 years, the most significant achievement of the organization has been its gradual {{5}} into a new type of regional cooperation organization that {{6}} the largest geographical area, represents the largest population, and {{7}} enormous development potential in the world. The SCO's most important experience for cooperation is that it has found the right way of {{8}} featuring non-alliances, non-{{9}} and not targeting any third party, while bringing countries in the region together to build a common home, he added. At the crossroads concerning the future of humanity, the SCO should shoulder its historic responsibility and take the initiative in steering the course of history, he said. Xi put forward a four-point proposal at the summit, calling on the SCO to stay committed to putting development and the people first, taking security as a key goal, and promoting dialogue and consultation.
paragraphs.cn: 今年是上合组织成立25周年。习近平表示，过去25年来，本组织最显著的成就是逐步转变为一个新型区域合作组织，其覆盖地域最广、人口最多，拥有巨大的发展潜力。上合组织最重要的合作经验在于找到了正确的共存之道，即不结盟、不对抗、不针对第三方，同时团结地区国家共建共同家园。在关乎人类未来的十字路口，上合组织应肩负起历史责任，主动引领历史进程。习近平在峰会上提出四点建议，呼吁上合组织坚持把发展和人民放在首位，把安全作为关键目标，并促进对话协商。

paragraphs.en: The SCO, Xi said, should champion a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization, {{10}} cooperation in traditional areas such as trade and investment, {{11}}, energy and resources, and expand cooperation in {{12}} areas such as artificial intelligence (AI), digital economy, green industry and green mining. China will develop an international AI application cooperation center with fellow SCO countries, establish a China-SCO port economic cooperation center in Tianjin, and implement 100 technological cooperation projects with other SCO countries in the next three years, he said. The SCO should pursue coordinated measures to {{13}} traditional and non-traditional security threats, Xi said, adding that the organization must prevent external forces from interfering in internal affairs, endangering political security, and {{14}} regional stability. China stands ready to work with all parties to act on the vision of common, {{15}}, cooperative and {{16}} security, and support the early opening of the SCO's four security centers, so as to upgrade the capacity of member states in responding to security threats and challenges, Xi said. According to Alexey Mukhin, director general of the Centre for Political Information in Moscow, the {{17}} of the SCO summit demonstrated that all member states are focusing on development and security priorities, and working together to address threats and challenges and promote long-term development through effective {{18}} within the SCO framework.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平表示，上合组织应倡导普惠包容的经济全球化，巩固贸易投资、互联互通、能源资源等传统领域合作，拓展人工智能、数字经济、绿色产业和绿色矿业等新兴领域合作。中国将同上合组织国家共同开发国际人工智能应用合作中心，在天津建立中国-上合组织港口经济合作中心，并在未来三年内同其他上合组织国家实施100个科技合作项目。习近平指出，上合组织应采取协调措施应对传统和非传统安全威胁，必须防止外部势力干涉内政、危害政治安全、破坏地区稳定。中国愿同各方一道，践行共同、综合、合作、可持续的安全观，支持上合组织四个安全中心早日启动，提升成员国应对安全威胁和挑战的能力。据莫斯科政治信息中心主任阿列克谢·穆欣称，上合组织峰会的成果表明，所有成员国都聚焦发展和安全优先事项，通过上合组织框架内的有效机制共同应对威胁和挑战，促进长期发展。

paragraphs.en: This not only serves the common interests of all parties, but also contributes to improving regional and global governance, Mukhin said. China stands ready to work with all parties to implement the Global Civilization Initiative, Xi said, adding that China will host SCO forums on innovation and sustainable development, on people-to-people friendship and on friendship cities, as well as establish a China-SCO basic education cooperation center. The SCO should always {{19}} that all countries, regardless of their size, are equal, and that regional affairs should be discussed by all countries to {{20}} differences and build consensus, properly handle differences through dialogue and consultation, and meet common challenges through {{21}} collaboration, Xi said. At the "SCO Plus" meeting, Xi called on the SCO to shoulder the responsibility of the times and work together to advance a more just and equitable global governance system, as well as an equal and orderly multipolar world. In his address, Xi noted that the trend toward a multipolar world is {{22}}, and multipolarity, independent choice of development paths, and greater democracy in international relations are the right way forward.
paragraphs.cn: 穆欣表示，这不仅符合各方的共同利益，也有助于改善地区和全球治理。习近平表示，中国愿同各方一道落实全球文明倡议，中国将举办上合组织创新与可持续发展论坛、民间友好论坛和友好城市论坛，并建立中国-上合组织基础教育合作中心。习近平指出，上合组织应始终倡导所有国家无论大小一律平等，地区事务应由各国共同讨论，以弥合分歧、凝聚共识，通过对话协商妥善处理分歧，通过多边协作应对共同挑战。在“上合+”会议上，习近平呼吁上合组织肩负起时代责任，共同推动更加公正合理的全球治理体系，以及平等有序的多极世界。习近平在讲话中指出，多极化趋势不可逆转，多极化、各国自主选择发展道路以及国际关系更加民主化是正确的前进方向。

paragraphs.en: Xi said that in recent years, the rise of the Global South is driving a {{23}} shift in the international balance of power. As an important part of a multipolar world and a key driving force behind it, the Global South countries ought to have greater representation and voice in international affairs, he said. Xi said that as a responsible major country, China advocates for an equal and orderly multipolar world, in which sovereign equality and mutual respect should be upheld as fundamental principles, balance, order and the rule of law as essential requirements, multipolarism, dialogue and consultation as key pathways, and mutual benefit, win-win cooperation and universally beneficial and inclusive development as the way forward. "Major countries in particular should take the lead in {{25}} international norms and honoring the rule of law, and work together to tackle global challenges," Xi said. China, as a major country, has set an example in this regard and played a leading role, said Seun Sam, a policy analyst at the Royal Academy of Cambodia.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平表示，近年来，全球南方的崛起正在推动国际力量对比发生深刻变化。作为多极世界的重要组成部分和关键推动力量，全球南方国家应在国际事务中拥有更大的代表性和发言权。习近平表示，作为负责任的大国，中国倡导平等有序的多极世界，其中主权平等和相互尊重应作为基本原则，平衡、秩序和法治作为基本要求，多边主义、对话协商作为关键路径，互利共赢、普惠包容的发展作为前进方向。“大国尤其应带头遵守国际规范、维护法治，共同应对全球挑战，”习近平说。柬埔寨皇家科学院政策分析师西恩·萨姆表示，中国作为大国，在这方面树立了榜样并发挥了引领作用。

paragraphs.en: "Major countries taking the lead in abiding by international law can have a {{26}} effect, help safeguard the sovereignty and interests of small countries like Cambodia, promote mutual trust among countries, and achieve peaceful coexistence," he said. Xi called on countries to promote the common values of humanity, advance the rule of law in international relations, restore the authority and vitality of the United Nations, and improve the coordination and efficiency of global and regional multilateral mechanisms. "We should focus on the development agenda, {{24}} openness and cooperation, and bridge the digital and AI divides, so that technological revolution and development achievements can benefit all nations," Xi said. Rahmon Ulmasov, a professor at the Russian-Tajik (Slavonic) University, said that with its deep experience in multilateral cooperation, the SCO has developed mature practices for {{27}} differences, building consensus and fostering cooperation. It enables countries with different political systems, cultural traditions and interests to engage in equal dialogue and practical cooperation, precisely what is needed to build a more just and equitable global governance system, Ulmasov said.

* China is ready to work with all parties to continue to strive for higher quality development, and make the global governance system more just and equitable, Chinese President Xi Jinping said on Tuesday during the 26th Meeting of the Council of Heads of State of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) and the "SCO Plus" meeting.
* At the crossroads concerning the future of humanity, the SCO should shoulder its historic responsibility and take the initiative in steering the course of history, he said.
* At the "SCO Plus" meeting, Xi called on the SCO to shoulder the responsibility of the times and work together to advance a more just and equitable global governance system, as well as an equal and orderly multipolar world.
Chinese President Xi Jinping said on Tuesday that China is ready to work with all parties to continue to strive for higher quality development, and make the global governance system more just and equitable.
Xi made the remarks in his speeches at the 26th Meeting of the Council of Heads of State of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) and the "SCO Plus" meeting held in the Kyrgyz capital of Bishkek.
This year marks the 25th founding anniversary of the SCO. Xi said that over the past 25 years, the most significant achievement of the organization has been its gradual transformation into a new type of regional cooperation organization that spans the largest geographical area, represents the largest population, and possesses enormous development potential in the world.
The SCO's most important experience for cooperation is that it has found the right way of coexistence featuring non-alliances, non-confrontation and not targeting any third party, while bringing countries in the region together to build a common home, he added.
At the crossroads concerning the future of humanity, the SCO should shoulder its historic responsibility and take the initiative in steering the course of history, he said.
Xi put forward a four-point proposal at the summit, calling on the SCO to stay committed to putting development and the people first, taking security as a key goal, and promoting dialogue and consultation.
The SCO, Xi said, should champion a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization, consolidate cooperation in traditional areas such as trade and investment, connectivity, energy and resources, and expand cooperation in emerging areas such as artificial intelligence (AI), digital economy, green industry and green mining.
China will develop an international AI application cooperation center with fellow SCO countries, establish a China-SCO port economic cooperation center in Tianjin, and implement 100 technological cooperation projects with other SCO countries in the next three years, he said.
The SCO should pursue coordinated measures to tackle traditional and non-traditional security threats, Xi said, adding that the organization must prevent external forces from interfering in internal affairs, endangering political security, and undermining regional stability.
China stands ready to work with all parties to act on the vision of common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security, and support the early opening of the SCO's four security centers, so as to upgrade the capacity of member states in responding to security threats and challenges, Xi said.
According to Alexey Mukhin, director general of the Centre for Political Information in Moscow, the outcomes of the SCO summit demonstrated that all member states are focusing on development and security priorities, and working together to address threats and challenges and promote long-term development through effective mechanisms within the SCO framework.
This not only serves the common interests of all parties, but also contributes to improving regional and global governance, Mukhin said.
China stands ready to work with all parties to implement the Global Civilization Initiative, Xi said, adding that China will host SCO forums on innovation and sustainable development, on people-to-people friendship and on friendship cities, as well as establish a China-SCO basic education cooperation center.
The SCO should always advocate that all countries, regardless of their size, are equal, and that regional affairs should be discussed by all countries to bridge differences and build consensus, properly handle differences through dialogue and consultation, and meet common challenges through multilateral collaboration, Xi said.
At the "SCO Plus" meeting, Xi called on the SCO to shoulder the responsibility of the times and work together to advance a more just and equitable global governance system, as well as an equal and orderly multipolar world.
In his address, Xi noted that the trend toward a multipolar world is irreversible, and multipolarity, independent choice of development paths, and greater democracy in international relations are the right way forward.
Xi said that in recent years, the rise of the Global South is driving a profound shift in the international balance of power. As an important part of a multipolar world and a key driving force behind it, the Global South countries ought to have greater representation and voice in international affairs, he said.
Xi said that as a responsible major country, China advocates for an equal and orderly multipolar world, in which sovereign equality and mutual respect should be upheld as fundamental principles, balance, order and the rule of law as essential requirements, multipolarism, dialogue and consultation as key pathways, and mutual benefit, win-win cooperation and universally beneficial and inclusive development as the way forward.
"Major countries in particular should take the lead in observing international norms and honoring the rule of law, and work together to tackle global challenges," Xi said.
China, as a major country, has set an example in this regard and played a leading role, said Seun Sam, a policy analyst at the Royal Academy of Cambodia.
"Major countries taking the lead in abiding by international law can have a demonstrative effect, help safeguard the sovereignty and interests of small countries like Cambodia, promote mutual trust among countries, and achieve peaceful coexistence," he said.
Xi called on countries to promote the common values of humanity, advance the rule of law in international relations, restore the authority and vitality of the United Nations, and improve the coordination and efficiency of global and regional multilateral mechanisms.
"We should focus on the development agenda, uphold openness and cooperation, and bridge the digital and AI divides, so that technological revolution and development achievements can benefit all nations," Xi said.
Rahmon Ulmasov, a professor at the Russian-Tajik (Slavonic) University, said that with its deep experience in multilateral cooperation, the SCO has developed mature practices for transcending differences, building consensus and fostering cooperation.
It enables countries with different political systems, cultural traditions and interests to engage in equal dialogue and practical cooperation, precisely what is needed to build a more just and equitable global governance system, Ulmasov said.
Highlighting the role of the SCO, Xi put forward three proposals for the organization to advance common prosperity, promote the development and rise of the Global South, and guide the reform and improvement of global governance, to make greater contributions to an equal and orderly multipolar world.
As an important pillar of South-South cooperation, the SCO should carry forward the Shanghai Spirit, strengthen and expand the "SCO Plus" partnerships, and jointly speak up for peace, foster synergy for development, build bridges for cooperation, and pave the way for win-win outcomes, Xi said.
"Let us take the people-centered and action-oriented approach, jointly advocate an equal and orderly multipolar world, make global governance more just and equitable, and build a community with a shared future for humanity," Xi said.

articles.title: Rescuers push deeper into mudslide-hit area at China-Nepal border
articles.titleCn: 救援人员深入中尼边境泥石流灾区
articles.summary: Rescuers are racing to search for survivors after a devastating mudslide, triggered by an ice-rock avalanche in Nepal, hit the border port of Gyirong in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region.
articles.summaryCn: 中尼边境吉隆口岸遭遇泥石流灾害，救援工作持续推进，同时尼泊尔也遭受重创，中国提供援助。

paragraphs.en:
Rescuers are racing to search for survivors after a {{0}} mudslide, {{1}} by an ice-rock {{2}} in Nepal, hit the border port of Gyirong in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region. The disaster, which occurred on August 26, has killed 16 people and left 546 people missing in Xizang. So far, more than 2,000 rescuers have joined search and rescue operations, including personnel from the Chinese People's Liberation Army, the People's Armed Police Force and China Anneng. A total of 269 rescue vehicles and 3,922 sets of rescue equipment have also been {{3}} to the front line. Rescue and relief work makes headway in core rescue zone
Despite difficulties such as high-altitude {{4}}, steep valleys and {{5}} weather, rescuers are pushing into the core disaster area, carrying out road mud removal, search and rescue operations, hazard {{6}}, {{7}} and epidemic prevention, and clearing and {{8}} damaged routes.
paragraphs.cn: 救援人员正在争分夺秒地搜寻幸存者，此前尼泊尔发生冰岩崩塌引发毁灭性泥石流，袭击了中国西南部西藏自治区吉隆口岸。这场灾害发生于8月26日，已造成西藏16人死亡，546人失踪。截至目前，已有2000多名救援人员参与搜救行动，包括中国人民解放军、武警部队和中国安能集团的人员。共有269辆救援车辆和3922套救援设备被派往前线。核心救援区的救援和救灾工作取得进展。尽管面临高海拔地形、陡峭山谷和多变天气等困难，救援人员仍深入核心灾区，开展道路清淤、搜救行动、危险识别、消毒防疫以及清理和恢复受损路线的工作。

paragraphs.en: So far, two rounds of searches have been completed in the core disaster zone, and further in‑depth searches will follow. Communications have been restored at the core rescue site, with successful phone calls made to rescuers at the port via a newly built base station. The first emergency communication base station near the border gate of Gyirong Port has started operating. Telecom operators in Xizang have restored one damaged base station and built eight new ones near the port. Rescue and disaster relief work still face great challenges as Gyirong County is expected to see more rainfall in the coming days, with significant nighttime {{9}}.
paragraphs.cn: 截至目前，核心灾区已完成两轮搜索，后续将进行更深入的搜索。核心救援现场的通信已恢复，通过新建的基站成功与口岸的救援人员通了电话。吉隆口岸边境门附近的首个应急通信基站已开始运行。西藏的电信运营商已修复一个受损基站，并在口岸附近新建了八个基站。救援和救灾工作仍面临巨大挑战，因为吉隆县未来几天预计会有更多降雨，夜间降水量显著。

paragraphs.en:
The meteorological authorities have advised caution in the Gyirong Port area over the next few days due to rainfall and {{10}} geological disaster risks. Communications support teams install a 5G base station in Gyirong County, southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region, August 30, 2026. Heavy-duty equipment {{11}} to clear the G216 national highway
Multiple rescue teams deployed heavy-duty equipment, including {{12}} and loaders, to clear the G216 national highway, a key road leading to Gyirong Port. Rescuers have advanced 533 meters as of 10 a.m. on Monday, leaving some 1.15 kilometers to go before reaching the port.
paragraphs.cn: 气象部门已建议未来几天在吉隆口岸地区保持警惕，因为降雨和地质灾害风险升高。通信保障团队于2026年8月30日在中国西南部西藏自治区吉隆县安装5G基站。部署重型设备清理G216国道。多个救援队部署了包括挖掘机和装载机在内的重型设备，以清理通往吉隆口岸的关键道路G216国道。截至周一上午10点，救援人员已推进533米，距到达口岸还有约1.15公里。

paragraphs.en: An expert with China Anneng Group identified three major challenges facing the operation. First, reopening the road is extremely difficult. Second, the machines are operating beside fast-flowing water, which lowers equipment efficiency and poses significant safety risks. Third, time is tight, and the task is {{13}}. Xizang is now in the flood season, with {{14}} upstream water conditions, which adds {{15}} to the road-clearing mission.
paragraphs.cn: 中国安能集团的一位专家指出了行动面临的三大挑战。首先，重新开通道路极其困难。其次，机器在湍急的水流旁作业，这降低了设备效率并带来重大安全风险。第三，时间紧迫，任务艰巨。西藏目前处于汛期，上游水情不确定，这增加了道路清理任务的紧迫性。

paragraphs.en:
Rescue teams work along the G216 National Highway in Gyirong County, southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region, August 30, 2026. Barrier lakes above mudslide-hit port basically {{16}}
China's Ministry of Water Resources said on Sunday that the Purepu Zangbo barrier lake above mudslide-hit Gyirong Port has largely drained, returning the river channel to a flowing state. It cited drone footage and {{17}} images captured in the morning, along with reports from emergency response teams. A new barrier lake that formed 2.8 kilometers downstream of the Purepu Zangbo barrier lake has also been largely drained. Drone footage and panoramic images show that upstream water has {{18}} the barrier lake, restoring the river channel to a flowing state.
paragraphs.cn: 救援队于2026年8月30日在中国西南部西藏自治区吉隆县沿G216国道工作。泥石流受灾口岸上方的堰塞湖基本排空。中国水利部周日表示，泥石流受灾的吉隆口岸上方的普普藏布堰塞湖已基本排空，河道恢复流动状态。它引用了上午拍摄的无人机画面和全景图像，以及应急响应小组的报告。普普藏布堰塞湖下游2.8公里处形成的一个新堰塞湖也已基本排空。无人机画面和全景图像显示，上游水已冲破堰塞湖，河道恢复流动状态。

paragraphs.en:
Authorities warn that an impact {{19}} upstream of the Purepu Zangbo barrier lake still needs attention. Located about 5.6 km upstream at an altitude of around 3,700 meters, the crater is roughly 800 meters higher than the barrier lake. China's Ministry of Natural Resources has launched investigations into dangers posed by the {{20}}. Experts have identified eight high-risk areas and will continue monitoring the situation. Post-disaster {{21}} support
Psychological support and counseling staff are helping the relocated residents find some level of {{22}}.
paragraphs.cn: 当局警告说，普普藏布堰塞湖上游的一个撞击坑仍需关注。该坑位于上游约5.6公里处，海拔约3700米，比堰塞湖高出约800米。中国自然资源部已对碎片构成的危险展开调查。专家已确定八个高风险区域，并将继续监测情况。灾后心理支持。心理支持和咨询人员正在帮助搬迁居民找到一定程度的稳定。

paragraphs.en: A psychological rescue expert team dispatched by the National Health Commission has arrived in Gyirong Town. Incorporating traditional Tibetan medical {{24}}, the experts are helping affected residents ease their emotions and relieve stress. Psychological rescue workers are also speaking with medical staff on the front lines to help them manage stress. Chinese relief supplies and four Chinese rescue experts arrived in Kathmandu on Sunday to assist the disaster relief efforts in Nepal. The supplies, which include tents, blankets, sleeping bags, hardtack and emergency kits, were handed over at Kathmandu's airport.

Rescuers are racing to search for survivors after a devastating mudslide, triggered by an ice-rock avalanche in Nepal, hit the border port of Gyirong in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region.
The disaster, which occurred on August 26, has killed 16 people and left 546 people missing in Xizang.
So far, more than 2,000 rescuers have joined search and rescue operations, including personnel from the Chinese People's Liberation Army, the People's Armed Police Force and China Anneng. A total of 269 rescue vehicles and 3,922 sets of rescue equipment have also been dispatched to the front line.
Rescue and relief work makes headway in core rescue zone
Despite difficulties such as high-altitude terrain, steep valleys and volatile weather, rescuers are pushing into the core disaster area, carrying out road mud removal, search and rescue operations, hazard identification, disinfection and epidemic prevention, and clearing and restoring damaged routes.
So far, two rounds of searches have been completed in the core disaster zone, and further in‑depth searches will follow.
Communications have been restored at the core rescue site, with successful phone calls made to rescuers at the port via a newly built base station. The first emergency communication base station near the border gate of Gyirong Port has started operating. Telecom operators in Xizang have restored one damaged base station and built eight new ones near the port.
Rescue and disaster relief work still face great challenges as Gyirong County is expected to see more rainfall in the coming days, with significant nighttime precipitation. The meteorological authorities have advised caution in the Gyirong Port area over the next few days due to rainfall and elevated geological disaster risks.
Communications support teams install a 5G base station in Gyirong County, southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region, August 30, 2026. 
Heavy-duty equipment deployed to clear the G216 national highway
Multiple rescue teams deployed heavy-duty equipment, including excavators and loaders, to clear the G216 national highway, a key road leading to Gyirong Port. Rescuers have advanced 533 meters as of 10 a.m. on Monday, leaving some 1.15 kilometers to go before reaching the port.
An expert with China Anneng Group identified three major challenges facing the operation. First, reopening the road is extremely difficult. Second, the machines are operating beside fast-flowing water, which lowers equipment efficiency and poses significant safety risks. Third, time is tight, and the task is arduous. Xizang is now in the flood season, with uncertain upstream water conditions, which adds urgency to the road-clearing mission.
Rescue teams work along the G216 National Highway in Gyirong County, southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region, August 30, 2026. 
Barrier lakes above mudslide-hit port basically drained
China's Ministry of Water Resources said on Sunday that the Purepu Zangbo barrier lake above mudslide-hit Gyirong Port has largely drained, returning the river channel to a flowing state. It cited drone footage and panoramic images captured in the morning, along with reports from emergency response teams.
A new barrier lake that formed 2.8 kilometers downstream of the Purepu Zangbo barrier lake has also been largely drained. Drone footage and panoramic images show that upstream water has breached the barrier lake, restoring the river channel to a flowing state.
Authorities warn that an impact crater upstream of the Purepu Zangbo barrier lake still needs attention. Located about 5.6 km upstream at an altitude of around 3,700 meters, the crater is roughly 800 meters higher than the barrier lake.
China's Ministry of Natural Resources has launched investigations into dangers posed by the debris. Experts have identified eight high-risk areas and will continue monitoring the situation.
Post-disaster psychological support
Psychological support and counseling staff are helping the relocated residents find some level of stability.
A psychological rescue expert team dispatched by the National Health Commission has arrived in Gyirong Town. Incorporating traditional Tibetan medical physiotherapy, the experts are helping affected residents ease their emotions and relieve stress. Psychological rescue workers are also speaking with medical staff on the front lines to help them manage stress.
Chinese relief supplies and four Chinese rescue experts arrived in Kathmandu on Sunday to assist the disaster relief efforts in Nepal.
The supplies, which include tents, blankets, sleeping bags, hardtack and emergency kits, were handed over at Kathmandu's airport. Chinese Ambassador to Nepal Zhang Maoming and Nepal's Minister of Science, Technology and Innovation Mahabir Pun attended the handover ceremony.
Pun has thanked the Chinese government for sending relief supplies and rescue teams to the disaster-hit areas. He said the assistance will help provide shelter, support reconstruction and clear blocked tunnel entrances at hydropower construction sites, where people are trapped.
The death toll from the devastating mudslide in Nepal has risen to 903, with 4,247 people still missing as of 9 a.m. local time on Monday, according to Nepal's National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority.
A total of 267 people have been injured, while 20,819 security personnel have been mobilized for search, rescue and relief operations, the authority said.

A new barrier lake that formed 2.8 kilometers downstream of the Purepu Zangbo barrier lake has also been largely drained. Drone footage and panoramic images show that upstream water has breached the barrier lake, restoring the river channel to a flowing state.
Authorities warn that an impact crater upstream of the Purepu Zangbo barrier lake still needs attention. Located about 5.6 km upstream at an altitude of around 3,700 meters, the crater is roughly 800 meters higher than the barrier lake.
China's Ministry of Natural Resources has launched investigations into dangers posed by the debris. Experts have identified eight high-risk areas and will continue monitoring the situation.
Post-disaster psychological support
Psychological support and counseling staff are helping the relocated residents find some level of stability.
A psychological rescue expert team dispatched by the National Health Commission has arrived in Gyirong Town. Incorporating traditional Tibetan medical physiotherapy, the experts are helping affected residents ease their emotions and relieve stress. Psychological rescue workers are also speaking with medical staff on the front lines to help them manage stress.
Chinese relief supplies and four Chinese rescue experts arrived in Kathmandu on Sunday to assist the disaster relief efforts in Nepal.
The supplies, which include tents, blankets, sleeping bags, hardtack and emergency kits, were handed over at Kathmandu's airport. Chinese Ambassador to Nepal Zhang Maoming and Nepal's Minister of Science, Technology and Innovation Mahabir Pun attended the handover ceremony.
Pun has thanked the Chinese government for sending relief supplies and rescue teams to the disaster-hit areas. He said the assistance will help provide shelter, support reconstruction and clear blocked tunnel entrances at hydropower construction sites, where people are trapped.
The death toll from the devastating mudslide in Nepal has risen to 903, with 4,247 people still missing as of 9 a.m. local time on Monday, according to Nepal's National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority.
A total of 267 people have been injured, while 20,819 security personnel have been mobilized for search, rescue and relief operations, the authority said.

救援人员正在争分夺秒地搜寻幸存者，此前尼泊尔境内冰岩崩塌引发的毁灭性泥石流袭击了中国西南部西藏自治区的吉隆口岸。这场发生于8月26日的灾害已造成西藏16人死亡，546人失踪。截至目前，已有2000多名救援人员参与搜救行动，包括中国人民解放军、武警部队和中国安能的人员。此外，269辆救援车辆和3922套救援设备已被派往前线。核心救援区的救援和救灾工作取得进展。尽管面临高海拔地形、陡峭山谷和变幻莫测的天气等困难，救援人员仍深入核心灾区，开展道路清淤、搜救行动、危险识别、消毒防疫以及清理和恢复受损路线的工作。

到目前为止，核心灾区已完成两轮搜索，后续将进行更深入的搜索。核心救援现场的通信已恢复，通过新建的基站成功与口岸的救援人员通了电话。吉隆口岸边境门附近的首个应急通信基站已开始运行。西藏的电信运营商已修复一个受损基站，并在口岸附近新建了八个基站。由于吉隆县未来几天预计会有更多降雨，且夜间降水显著，救援和救灾工作仍面临巨大挑战。

气象部门建议未来几天在吉隆口岸地区保持警惕，因为降雨和地质灾害风险升高。通信保障团队于2026年8月30日在中国西南部西藏自治区吉隆县安装5G基站。部署重型设备清理G216国道。多个救援队部署了包括挖掘机和装载机在内的重型设备，以清理通往吉隆口岸的关键道路G216国道。截至周一上午10时，救援人员已推进533米，距到达口岸还有约1.15公里。

中国安能集团的一位专家指出了行动面临的三大挑战。首先，重新开通道路极其困难。其次，机器在湍急的水流旁作业，这降低了设备效率并带来重大安全风险。第三，时间紧迫，任务艰巨。西藏目前正值汛期，上游水情不确定，这增加了道路清理任务的紧迫性。

救援队于2026年8月30日在中国西南部西藏自治区吉隆县的G216国道上工作。泥石流受灾口岸上方的堰塞湖基本排空。中国水利部周日表示，泥石流受灾的吉隆口岸上方的普普藏布堰塞湖已基本排空，河道恢复流动状态。它引用了上午拍摄的无人机画面和全景图像，以及应急响应小组的报告。普普藏布堰塞湖下游2.8公里处形成的一个新堰塞湖也已基本排空。无人机画面和全景图像显示，上游水已冲过堰塞湖，河道恢复流动状态。

国家卫生健康委员会派出的心理救援专家组已抵达吉隆镇。结合传统藏医理疗，专家们正在帮助受灾居民缓解情绪和减轻压力。心理救援人员还与一线医务人员交谈，帮助他们管理压力。中国救援物资和四名中国救援专家于周日抵达加德满都，协助尼泊尔的救灾工作。这些物资包括帐篷、毯子、睡袋、压缩饼干和应急包，已在加德满都机场移交。

中国驻尼泊尔大使张茂明和尼泊尔科学、技术与创新部长马哈比尔·蓬出席了交接仪式。蓬感谢中国政府向灾区发送救援物资和救援队。他说，这些援助将有助于提供住所、支持重建，并清理水电建设工地被困人员所在的堵塞隧道入口。据尼泊尔国家灾害风险减少与管理局称，截至当地时间周一上午9时，尼泊尔毁灭性泥石流的死亡人数已升至903人，仍有4247人失踪。
